package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type learningActionReaderStub struct {
	action domain.StudentLearningAction
	err    error
}

func (stub learningActionReaderStub) GetByStudentAndID(
	context.Context,
	string,
	string,
) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error) {
	return stub.action, stub.err
}

var _ repository.LearningActionReader = learningActionReaderStub{}

func TestGetLearningActionContextProjectsTrustedSnapshotWithoutOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	actionID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	openedAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	useCase := GetLearningActionContext{Actions: learningActionReaderStub{action: domain.StudentLearningAction{
		ID:                   actionID,
		StudentTaskAnswerID:  "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		StudentID:            studentID,
		TaskID:               "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		Cycle:                1,
		ContextType:          domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:            "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		LearningTargets:      []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}},
		EvidenceClass:        domain.LearningEvidenceApplication,
		Outcome:              domain.LearningActionPassed,
		OutcomePolicyVersion: domain.MasteryPolicyVersion,
		OpenedAt:             openedAt,
	}}}

	got, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), studentID, actionID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if got.LearningActionID != actionID || got.StudentID != studentID || got.Status != domain.LearningActionStatusOpen {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected action identity/status: %+v", got)
	}
	if got.TaskID != "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444" || got.ContextType != domain.LearningContextLessonTask {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected context: %+v", got)
	}
	if len(got.LearningTargets) != 1 || got.LearningTargets[0].Key != "go.errors" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected targets: %+v", got.LearningTargets)
	}
	if !got.OpenedAt.Equal(openedAt) {
		t.Fatalf("opened_at=%s, want %s", got.OpenedAt, openedAt)
	}
}

func TestGetLearningActionContextProjectsClosedLifecycleWithoutOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	closedAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 11, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	useCase := GetLearningActionContext{Actions: learningActionReaderStub{action: domain.StudentLearningAction{
		ID:          "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentID:   "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		TaskID:      "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask,
		ContextID:   "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		OpenedAt:    closedAt.Add(-time.Hour),
		ClosedAt:    &closedAt,
	}}}

	got, err := useCase.Handle(
		context.Background(),
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if got.Status != domain.LearningActionStatusClosed {
		t.Fatalf("status=%q, want CLOSED", got.Status)
	}
}

func TestGetLearningActionContextFailsClosedOnInvalidOrMismatchedIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	actionID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"

	if _, err := (GetLearningActionContext{Actions: learningActionReaderStub{}}).Handle(context.Background(), "invalid", actionID); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("invalid student error=%v, want validation", err)
	}

	useCase := GetLearningActionContext{Actions: learningActionReaderStub{action: domain.StudentLearningAction{
		ID:          actionID,
		StudentID:   "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
		TaskID:      "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:   "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		OpenedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
	}}}
	if _, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), studentID, actionID); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("mismatched identity error=%v, want validation", err)
	}
}
